Specification: VoteProof: PlusCal specification with TLA+ translation for voting-based consensus (Paxos ballot voting layer). Models acceptors using votes (function from Acceptor to sets of <ballot, value> pairs) and maxBal. Defines SafeAt via a recursive LET function SA, invariants VInv1-4 and VInv, actions IncreaseMaxBal/VoteFor/BallotAction, LiveAssumption, and LiveSpec. Instantiates Consensus (C == INSTANCE Consensus). Proves invariance (VT2: Spec => []VInv), refinement (VT3: Spec => C!Spec), unique choice (VT1), quorum ballot theorem (VT4), and liveness (LiveSpec => C!LiveSpec).
